name: Fight Colorectal Cancer
mission: We fight to cure colorectal cancer and serve as relentless champions of hope for all affected by this disease through informed patient support, impactful policy change, and breakthrough research endeavors.
theoryOfChange: Fight Colorectal Cancer has a published strategic framework called the Colorectal Cancer Care Initiative (CRCCI), detailed in their Colorectal Cancer Care Report. This initiative is a national coalition uniting patient advocates, physicians, public health champions, and healthcare leaders around data-driven goals to transform colorectal cancer screening, diagnosis, and treatment. The framework establishes clear, actionable goals, such as achieving an 80% screening rate for average-risk patients and ensuring 80% of patients with an abnormal non-invasive screening test receive a follow-up colonoscopy within 90 days. It also aims for 80% of patients to initiate treatment within six weeks of diagnosis, and for 80% of patients diagnosed with stage III or IV CRC to receive biomarker and genetic testing. The report utilizes real-world data, scientific literature, and patient experience to set these goals for improving prevention, diagnosis, and care nationwide.

strengths_deep_dive: Fight CRC demonstrates a high level of organizational maturity through its diverse program offerings. In 2025 alone, the organization <cite id="4">distributed 30,000 resources to clinics</cite> and supported <cite id="4">1,700 medical facilities</cite> across the country. Beyond education, they are a significant funder of medical advancement, providing <cite id="4">$1,000,000 in research funding</cite> to combat colorectal cancer. Their <cite id="6">Research Advocacy Training & Support (RATS) program</cite> empowers patients to participate directly in the research process, ensuring the patient voice is heard in clinical settings. This combination of grassroots support and institutional funding is a hallmark of their operational model.
rich_narrative.summary: Fight Colorectal Cancer (Fight CRC) is a national advocacy organization dedicated to disease awareness, research funding, and legislative policy in the United States. Since its <cite id="14">founding in 2005</cite>, the organization has established itself as a safe harbor for patients and caregivers while pushing for medical breakthroughs. In FY2025, the organization reported <cite id="2">total revenue of $3,060,301</cite>, reflecting a stable financial base for its advocacy and research initiatives. The charity operates with a high degree of transparency, evidenced by its <cite id="1">overall score of 98.0/100 from Charity Navigator</cite> and its <cite id="15">Platinum Seal of Transparency from Candid</cite>. Its work is balanced between direct patient support and high-level policy change, having successfully influenced <cite id="5">federal laws related to cancer screening</cite>. While the organization maintains a <cite id="1">program expense ratio of 81.4%</cite>, which is above the 75% industry benchmark, its impact is primarily domestic. For donors seeking to support global health through a lens of advocacy and research, Fight CRC offers a professionally managed, high-accountability platform. However, its focus remains concentrated on the U.S.
